mapper.sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.patient_id = p.id AND r.miss = 1)

SELECT q.patient_id, q.rule_code FROM (
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, 'M_DAS28' AS rule_code FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = p.id AND f.bqpg LIKE '%DAS28%') UNION ALL
SELECT p.id, 'M_BASELINE_LAB' FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = p.id AND COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) = ( SELECT MIN(COALESCE(f2.follow_up_date, f2.followUpDate)) FROM patient_follow_up_history f2 WHERE f2.patient_basic_info_id = p.id) AND IFNULL(TRIM(f.fzjc), '') NOT IN ('', '{}', '[]', 'null')) UNION ALL
SELECT p.id, 'M_COMORBIDITY' FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE IFNULL(TRIM(p.jws), '') IN ('', '{}', '[]', 'null') UNION ALL
SELECT p.id, 'M_MEDICATION' FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = p.id AND IFNULL(TRIM(f.zlfa), '') NOT IN ('', '{}', '[]', 'null')) UNION ALL
SELECT p.id, 'L_DATE_ORDER' FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE COALESCE(p.happen_date, p.happenDate) > COALESCE(p.confirm_date, p.confirmDate) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = p.id AND (COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) < COALESCE(p.happen_date, p.happenDate) OR COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) > NOW())) UNION ALL
SELECT p.id, 'L_ASSESSMENT' FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE (p.smoke = 0 AND (IFNULL(COALESCE(p.smoke_years, p.smokeYears), 0) > 0 OR IFNULL(COALESCE(p.smoke_count_by_day, p.smokeCountByDay), 0) > 0)) OR (p.drink = 0 AND (IFNULL(COALESCE(p.drink_years, p.drinkYears), 0) > 0 OR IFNULL(COALESCE(p.drink_count_by_day, p.drinkCountByDay), 0) > 0)) OR COALESCE(p.acr_eular_score, p.acrEularScore) NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10 ) q

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dueCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = p.id AND COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{cycleDays} DAY) AND COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) <= NOW() ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS doneCount FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE AND COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{cycleDays} DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE AND COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = p.id), COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate) ) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{cycleDays} DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS issueCount, COUNT(DISTINCT t.patient_id) AS patientCount FROM () t

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(TRIM(f.bqpg), '') NOT IN ('', '{}', '[]', 'null') AND IFNULL(TRIM(f.fzjc), '') NOT IN ('', '{}', '[]', 'null') AND IFNULL(TRIM(f.zlfa), '') NOT IN ('', '{}', '[]', 'null')
